-- Trust-policy prose may mention `partial def`, `unsafe def`, sorry, axiom,
-- native_decide, extern and implemented_by.
/- Nested comments: /- partial unsafe sorry axiom -/ remain prose. -/
/-- Documentation may mention `partial`, `unsafe`, `sorry` and `axiom`. -/
private def plantedTrustVocabulary : String := "partial unsafe sorry axiom native_decide"
/-! Module documentation may also mention `partial`, `unsafe` and `sorry`. -/
private def plantedRawTrustVocabulary : String := r#"partial "unsafe" sorry"#
private def plantedInterpolatedTrustVocabulary : String := s!"partial unsafe sorry {1}"
private def plantedTrustCharacter : Char := 'u'
private def «unsafe» : Nat := 0
private def «partial» : Nat := 0
private def «sorry» : Nat := 0
private def «axiom» : Nat := 0
-- `admit` is refused only as a keyword, and is not one at this pin: it is the
-- name of `Effects.admit`, which the flow batteries call unqualified.
private def admit : Nat := 0
private def plantedAdmitUse : Nat := admit
-- An `opaque` with a body is not a bodyless one; only the latter is refused.
opaque plantedOpaqueWithBody : Nat := 0

private theorem plantedProjection (a b c : Nat)
    (h : True ∧ a = b) (step : b = c) : a = c := h.2.trans step

private theorem plantedNestedProjection (a b c : Nat)
    (h : (True ∧ a = b) ∧ True) (step : b = c) : a = c := h.1.2.trans step

private theorem plantedPipeProjection (a b c : Nat)
    (h : True ∧ a = b) (step : b = c) : a = c := h |>.2.trans step

private def plantedDecimal : Float := 1.25
private def plantedScientific : Float := 1.25e3
